column1: # Sample EMV merchant-presented QR payloads for your codec tests.
# Built for this project (they are not taken from the EMVCo document). Each CRC was
# computed with Python's binascii.crc_hqx(data, 0xFFFF), an independent CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE
# implementation, so they can check your code without depending on it.
# Outcomes: VALID, BAD_CRC (checksum does not match), BAD_STRUCTURE (checksum matches but
# the TLV fields do not parse), MISSING_MANDATORY (parses, but a required object is absent),
# BAD_ORDER (parses, but the payload format indicator "00" is not first).
